title: Full AES-256 weak-pair related-key trail with 19 state and 5 schedule active S-boxes, BKN 2009

target.description: One specified full-round AES-256 related-key differential trail, with the first two rounds given in AppendixA p.247 and the remaining rounds inherited from Table2. It is not a minimum-S-box lower bound.

setting.key_relation: Fixed master-key XOR relation K and K XOR DeltaK from Appendix A. Five active key-schedule S-box transitions restrict the pair.
setting.key_population: A qualifying weak related-key pair of estimated incidence 2^-35; discovering such a pair is excluded from this conditional configuration.
setting.plaintext_model: Chosen plaintext pairs with the exact Appendix A distinguisher input difference, written row by row: (0e, 0e, 0e, 0e); (07, 07, 07, 07); (07, 07, 07, 07); (09, 09, 09, 09). This is the fixed distinguisher trail, separate from the expanded checkerboard recovery structures.
assumptions: The stated key pair satisfies the five key-schedule transitions of the source weak-pair trail.
The 19-state-S-box nominal probability product is conditional on that pair; neither it nor the weak-pair incidence is a completed-attack success probability.

property.statement: The specified full14-round trail has 19 active state S-boxes with nominal transition product 2^-119 and five active key-schedule S-boxes with product 2^-35.
property.quantifier: Existential author-reported fixed differential trail; no all-key statement, minimum-active-S-box theorem, or independent attack-success claim is asserted.
property.scope: AppendixA related-key first-two-round variant plus shared rounds3–14, under the actual AES-256 key schedule.

parameters.name: state_active
parameters.meaning: Fourteen state transitions have DDT count4, and five have DDT count2.

parameters.name: state_exponent
parameters.meaning: Negative log2 of the nominal state transition product conditional on the weak key pair.

parameters.name: schedule_exponent
parameters.meaning: Five active key-schedule transitions each have DDT count2; source weak-pair density estimate.

validation.description: Original source trail, AppendixA constants and reported probability analysis checked. Independent finite test recomputes the AES S-box DDT, all state linear layers and final whitening, and the key-difference recurrence. It establishes local compatibility and arithmetic only; the full attack, global trail/TA distribution and numerical success remain unreproduced.

success.description: Supporting specified-trail property; its S-box transition product is not a numerical completed-attack success probability.

evidence.locator: PDF12 / printed p.242 Section4.1; PDF17–19 / printed pp.247–249 AppendixA and Table2.
evidence.interpretation: Source constants are preserved as one explicit supporting trail, separate from a completed recovery or a q-multicollision target.

limitations: This is one explicit supporting trail, not a globally optimal or minimum-active-S-box theorem.
Local DDT compatibility and linear-layer checks do not establish joint realizability, TA independence, or a completed attack.
Source-native nominal products and reported experiments are not promoted to independently proved end-to-end probabilities.
